responsibility: Declares the AST visitor that performs Rust unstable-feature gating before HIR-based analysis. It exposes the crate entry point, a helper for reporting gated-feature diagnostics, and the full set of AST visit hooks, serving as the interface for a pass that interprets #![feature] attributes and checks syntax or item forms that require enabled experimental features.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface half of the feature-gate pair: unlike rust-feature-gate.cc, it declares the AST visitor, check entry point, gate helper, and extensive visit surface, but not the attribute parsing or gated diagnostic logic.
